text:
jeremy: quick check — onboarding CI failed because it can't find the weights for optoral-13b-v2. script expects `s3://redwood-weights/optoral/13b/v2/` but logs show 404. also seeing a tokenizer quirk where `` is tokenized as separate tokens in our unit tests. sharing config i'm testing below, need quick thumbs before i push to staging.

maya: we moved that model under the consolidated models bucket last week. new path is `s3://models/optoral/optoral-13b-v2/` (note the extra `optoral` segment). update the onboarding script or the model manifest path. also check for `optoral-13b-v2.sha256` next to the weights.

sam: tokenizer quirk — yup, seen that. tokenizer v0.9.1 splits `` into multiple tokens for some datasets; v0.9.2 fixes the merge rule. add `tokenizer_version: \"0.9.2\"` to the manifest and run the roundtrip test. i'll add a quick test. :+1:

nora: for serving config tuning, some quick practical knobs we've been using for similar 13B mixes:
- `continuous_batching: true`
- `max_concurrent_sequences: 64`
- `batch_time_limit_ms: 18`
- `max_tokens_per_request: 2048`
- enable prefix caching with `prefix_kv_ttl_s: 60` and LRU eviction for short-chat models
also consider `scheduler.preempt_policy: \"latency-first\"` for canary rollout.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: CI failure at 2028-11-02T10:21:05Z — GET s3://redwood-weights/optoral/13b/v2/ returned 404. Rollback triggered by autopilot.

jeremy: thanks everyone. i'll update paths and tokenizer_version in the manifest and push a PR. pinging @maya and @sam for config & tokenizer reviews. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/ml-onboard/pulls/387 (will include small integration test). :eyes:

maya: quick note on sharded/quantized weights — if weights are split across N shards, add `weight_shards: 4` (or whatever count) to the manifest. otherwise the runtime will attempt to load a single monolithic file and error out.

sam: adding the roundtrip tokenization test now. test will assert `encode(decode(x)) == encode(x)` for a few edge-case strings including `` and some unicode. will push a patch and tag tokenizer v0.9.2.

nora: one more micro-tweak: set `max_batch_tokens: 8192` (this keeps batch sizes efficient for the `max_concurrent_sequences` above). be careful with memory calc if quantized TFLOPS settings change. also `kv_cache_shards: 2` helps on multi-GPU dedicated hosts.

jeremy: assembling final config snippet for the PR — feel free to nit:```yaml
model: optoral-13b-v2
weights_path: s3://models/optoral/optoral-13b-v2/
tokenizer_version: \"0.9.2\"
weight_shards: 4
runtime:
  continuous_batching: true
  max_concurrent_sequences: 64
  batch_time_limit_ms: 18
  max_batch_tokens: 8192
  max_tokens_per_request: 2048
  prefix_kv_ttl_s: 60
  kv_cache_shards: 2
scheduler:
  preempt_policy: \"latency-first\"
  eviction_policy: \"lru\"
```

maya: LGTM. small ask: add a smoke test step in the onboarding pipeline that verifies `sha256` + tokenization roundtrip before promoting. once tests pass i'll approve. :thumbsup:

sam: tagged tokenizer release, pushed tests. i'll monitor canary after maya merges.

jeremy: thank you all — merging after tests. will watch staging for 24h and report back here with perf numbers. :rocket:
